mcq.q: Naye Laravel project ka default database kaunsa hai?
mcq.why: Naye project mein `.env` SQLite use karta hai aur `database/database.sqlite` ban jaati hai.

mcq.q: Laravel installer se naya project banane ki command?
mcq.why: `laravel new example-app` naya project banata hai.

mcq.q: Web server ka document root kaunsa folder hona chahiye?
mcq.why: Sirf `public` web se accessible hona chahiye.
`php artisan key:generate` naya key set karta hai.

mcq.q: Application code mein config value kaise padhni chahiye?
mcq.why: Config cache ke saath safe rehne ke liye `config()` use karo.

mcq.q: Laravel 13 chalane ke liye minimum PHP kaunsa hai?
mcq.why: Laravel 13 ke liye PHP 8.3 ya upar chahiye.

interview.a: Open-source PHP web framework jo routing, database access, templating, queues aur testing jaise features structured tareeke se deta hai.

interview.q: Why do we serve Laravel from the public folder?
interview.a: Taaki `.env`, `app` aur `vendor` jaisi private files web se access na ho sakein.
`env()` `.env` se raw value padhta hai. `config()` config files se padhta hai jo cache ho sakti hain, isliye code mein `config()` use karte hain.

interview.q: What does composer run dev do?
interview.a: `composer.json` ki `dev` script chalata hai jo development server, queue worker aur Vite ek saath start karti hai.

interview.q: What changed in the Laravel 11 structure?
interview.a: Skeleton slim hua: Kernel files, Exception Handler aur RouteServiceProvider hataye gaye aur configuration `bootstrap/app.php` mein aayi.
Laravel ka command line tool jo code generate karta hai aur routine kaam (migrate, route:list, tinker) chalata hai.
